data.name: Guruprasad
data.gender_notes: Guruprasad is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Guruprasad is derived from Sanskrit words 'Guru' (teacher, guide) and 'Prasad' (blessing, grace). This name signifies receiving the blessings and grace of a revered teacher or guru. The name Guruprasad carries the meaning “Blessing from the Guru” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Guruprasad usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing from the guru and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Receiving the blessings of a spiritual guide
data.etymology: Guruprasad belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessing from the Guru.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guruprasad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Guruprasad holds immense cultural significance in Hindu society. It reflects the deep respect and reverence for the guru or teacher in the Hindu tradition. In Hinduism, the guru is believed to be a spiritual mentor and guide, who imparts wisdom and knowledge to help the disciple on their spiritual journey. The name highlights the importance of seeking the guidance of a guru and receiving their blessings for personal growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Guruprasad signifies the receipt of divine grace and blessings. It is a reminder of the importance of humility and surrender before a teacher or God, and the recognition that true knowledge and enlightenment can only be gained through the guidance of a guru. The name also symbolizes the deep spiritual bond between the guru and disciple, with the guru bestowing their blessings upon the disciple to help them on their spiritual path.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Guruprasad: A soul graced by the guidance of a spiritual guru, receiving blessings and wisdom for spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Guruprasad was a title given to the revered guru of Sri Ramakrishna. The name Guruprasad carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Sri Ramakrishna was a 19th-century Indian mystic who is regarded as a saint and a spiritual teacher. Guruprasad was the title given to the guru who succeeded Sri Ramakrishna and headed the Ramakrishna Mission.

historical_references.reference: Guruprasad was also the name of the chief disciple of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu in Bengal, India during the 16th century.
historical_references.context: Chaitanya Mahaprabhu was a prominent figure in the Bengal bhakti movement in the 16th century. Guruprasad was one of his prominent disciples, known for his devotion and scholarship.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Guruprasad' has modern relevance in various contexts, particularly in the fields of technology, education, and spirituality. On professional networking site LinkedIn, it can represent a skilled professional who has been blessed with the guidance of a guru. On Medium, it can be the title of a thoughtful and insightful piece on the importance of having a spiritual guide in one's life. On Quora, it can be a question about the significance and meaning of the name Guruprasad in Hindu culture. Overall, the name has a timeless and profound meaning, reflecting the importance of learning, guidance, and the spiritual journey.
